sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Surface treatment (subcontracted to Anodica Veneta S.r.l.)
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: The proposal moves BR-220 anodising (control plan step 50, currently subcontracted to Anodica Veneta) to Rivestimenti Nord S.r.l. for 3 lots. The approved source list only covers billet sources for BR-220 at TO1 for STL. No controlled record in the documents covers an anodising subcontractor for this part, plant and customer. Rivestimenti Nord's absence therefore cannot be read as 'not approved', and someone must confirm whether it holds a current release.
